@fig-diag-gal and @fig-diag-acid give the diagnostics for the strongest and the weakest
of the five models. In both, the residuals scatter about zero with no trend against the
predicted value and no fan, and the actual against predicted points sit on the identity
line. The largest standardized residual in the galactosylation model is
`{python} f"{max_std_resid('galactosylation'):.1f}"` and in the acidic variants model
`{python} f"{max_std_resid('acidic_variants'):.1f}"`, and neither residual set departs
from normality (Shapiro-Wilk p = `{python} f"{shapiro_p('galactosylation'):.2f}"` and
`{python} f"{shapiro_p('acidic_variants'):.2f}"`). No run was excluded from any fit.

## Mechanistic interpretation

The surfaces behave as the platform mechanisms predict, with one exception that the
study quantifies without explaining. Galactosylation falls as the culture ages, which is
what a declining galactosyltransferase activity and a depleting nucleotide sugar pool
produce. Dissolved carbon dioxide lowers it further, and the accepted mechanism for that
is an acidified Golgi lumen: transferase activity and nucleotide sugar transport both
fall as lumenal pH drops away from the enzyme optimum. Culture temperature raises
galactosylation in the same picture, through the rate constant of the transfer reaction.

The pH by duration interaction on galactosylation follows from the same account. At the
short duration edge of the range the transferase is still active, and raising culture pH
lowers the product by
`{python} f"{abs(D.predict(UO,'galactosylation',coded={'pH':1,'temperature':0,'duration':-1,'co2':0})[0] - D.predict(UO,'galactosylation',coded={'pH':-1,'temperature':0,'duration':-1,'co2':0})[0]):.1f}"`
percentage points. At the long duration edge the same move changes it by
`{python} f"{abs(D.predict(UO,'galactosylation',coded={'pH':1,'temperature':0,'duration':1,'co2':0})[0] - D.predict(UO,'galactosylation',coded={'pH':-1,'temperature':0,'duration':1,'co2':0})[0]):.1f}"`
points. Once the enzyme system is depleted, the pH of the culture has little left to act
on. An operating region built from one dimensional ranges would not represent that,
which is the argument for the multivariate region (§6).

High mannose behaves as an incomplete trimming attribute: the Golgi mannosidases work
best at an acidic lumenal pH, and raising the culture pH raises the lumenal pH away from
that optimum, which leaves more of the untrimmed precursor in the released product.
Higher culture temperature drives trimming further towards completion and lowers high
mannose. Neither dissolved carbon dioxide nor culture duration moves the attribute
measurably, which is consistent with trimming reaching the endpoint well before harvest.

Afucosylation reflects a competition between core fucosyltransferase activity and the
rate at which antibody transits the secretory pathway. Longer culture lowers
afucosylation, because slower transit gives the transferase more time to act on each
molecule. The curvature in culture pH says that the competition has an optimum inside
the range instead of at an edge: the highest predicted afucosylation over a pH scan at
the set-point of the other factors is
`{python} f"{max(D.predict(UO,'afucosylation',coded={'pH':x,'temperature':0,'duration':0,'co2':0})[0] for x in np.linspace(-1,1,41)):.1f}"`
%, and the level falls at both edges.

Aggregate is not enzymatic. Antibody that sits longer in an ageing broth, at a higher pH
and in the presence of proteases released by dying cells, aggregates more, and both
significant factors act in that direction. The effect is small in absolute terms across
the whole characterized range, at `{python} f"{eff('aggregates_hmw','pH'):.2f}"`
percentage points for culture pH. Aggregate is nonetheless worth close attention here, as
the only attribute of the five that downstream steps also change, and the cation exchange
step is sized against the level this step delivers (PCR-007).

Acidic variants carry the exception. Dissolved carbon dioxide lowers them, and the
deamidation mechanism accounts for that directly, since an acidified culture fluid slows
a base catalysed reaction, and culture temperature raises them in the way the rate
constant predicts. However, culture pH lowers acidic variants as well, and solution
chemistry predicts the opposite. The most likely account is an indirect one through cell
physiology and through the age distribution of product in the harvest, and the study
does not separate those possibilities. The response surface model quantifies the effect
without attributing it, and the classification of culture pH in §9 rests on the effects
it has on the glycan attributes.

Finally, dropping osmolality from the response surface design has a cost that belongs
here. Screening resolved an interaction between culture temperature and osmolality on
galactosylation of `{python} f"{eff('galactosylation','temperature','osmolality'):.1f}"`
percentage points (p =
`{python} f"{eff_p('galactosylation','temperature','osmolality'):.3f}"`). That term is
represented in this report by the screening estimate alone, and no quadratic or
predictive statement is made about that term. The narrow recipe control of osmolality is
what keeps the omission acceptable, and §11 carries it as a limitation.

# Design space

The design space of the production bioreactor is a multivariate region in
`{python} rsm_list`, over which the fitted response surface models predict that every
attribute the step governs stays within the in-process criterion. The region is a subset
of the characterized knowledge space in @tbl-params, and the normal operating ranges sit
inside the region over almost all of their extent [@amab2009]. One corner of the normal
operating range does not, and §7 reports it.

The criteria the region is judged against are the step's in-process limits, not the drug
substance specifications. For `{python} n_from_cap` of the `{python} n_resp` responses
the in-process limit is an alert limit set at `{python} f"{alert_sigma:g}"` standard
deviations above the simulated commercial scale mean, because those attributes are
neither cleared nor modified downstream and the drug substance criterion sits far
outside the spread of the process itself. For aggregate the limit is carried back from
the drug substance criterion through the clearance the downstream train delivers,
divided by an assurance margin of `{python} f"{agg_margin:g}"`. Both bases give a limit
that binds well inside the drug substance criterion, and the in-process limits used in
§7 and here are the more demanding comparison of the two available.

Evaluated on an evenly spaced grid of `{python} f"{ds_n:,}"` points across the four
characterized ranges, `{python} f"{ds_pct:.0f}"` % of the region meets every criterion
simultaneously. The largest share of the grid is rejected by `{python} ds_bind.lower()`,
at `{python} f"{ds_bind_pct:.0f}"` % of the points, and the smallest by
`{python} ds_easy.lower()`, at `{python} f"{ds_easy_pct:.0f}"` %. The characterized ranges therefore contain edges of
failure, which is the intended outcome of choosing ranges wider than the control ranges.

The worst case corner of the characterized region is the one that fails
`{python} ds_bind.lower()`: `{python} wc_char_corner(ds['binding'])`. At that corner the
model predicts `{python} f"{wc_char(ds['binding']):.1f}"` %, against an in-process limit
of `{python} f"{ipc_hi(ds['binding']):.1f}"` % and a drug substance criterion of
`{python} ds_range(ds['binding'])` %. That single corner exceeds even the drug substance
criterion, which is what an edge of failure means and why the design space is smaller
than the knowledge space.

The principal planes of the region are culture pH against culture duration, shown in
@fig-contours, and dissolved carbon dioxide against culture temperature, shown in
@fig-contours-co2. The first plane carries the interaction that drives galactosylation
and afucosylation, and the second carries the gradient that drives acidic variants. A
design space stated as four independent ranges would miss the first of those entirely,
because the acceptable pH range at the short duration edge is not the acceptable pH
range at the long one.

Under ICH Q8, operation anywhere inside the region is not a change from a regulatory
filing perspective [@ichq8]. Movement within the region still runs through the
pharmaceutical quality system as a planned change with a prospective risk assessment
[@ichq10], and movement outside the region requires change control and supporting data.
The normal operating ranges in @tbl-params are where the commercial process is expected
to run, and they occupy a small part of the region, with the exception noted in §7.

Three bounds apply to this claim. The region is defined by mean predictions from models
fitted over the characterized ranges, and says nothing about settings outside those
ranges. The models were fitted on a qualified scale down system, and commercial scale
confirmation is a Stage 2 activity. The region covers the four response surface factors
only, with osmolality and the four univariately assessed parameters held inside the
ranges in @tbl-params.

# Proven acceptable ranges

For a single parameter at a time, proven acceptable ranges complement the multivariate
region with a per attribute statement of how far a single parameter may move. @tbl-par
gives both analyses for every combination of governed attribute and response surface
factor: the range proven with the other factors at their set-points, and the range that
survives normal operating range co-variation of the other factors.

```{python}
#| output: asis
show(D.par_table(UO))
print()
print(": Proven acceptable ranges per governed attribute and response-surface factor. {#tbl-par}")
```

The acceptance basis is stated in the Criterion column and is the same in-process limit
used for the design space (§6). Reading the table against the drug substance criteria
instead would widen every range in the table.

With the other factors at their set-points, `{python} n_par_full` of the
`{python} n_par_rows` combinations return the entire characterization range as a proven
acceptable range. The four that do not are informative. Afucosylation and
galactosylation both restrict culture duration at the short end, to
`{python} par_sp('afucosylation','duration')` days and
`{python} par_sp('galactosylation','duration')` days against a characterized range of
`{python} rng('duration')` days. Acidic variants restrict dissolved carbon dioxide at
the low end, to `{python} par_sp('acidic_variants','co2')` mmHg against a characterized
range of `{python} rng('co2')` mmHg. Aggregate restricts culture duration at the long
end, to `{python} par_sp('aggregates_hmw','duration')` days.

Under normal operating range co-variation the ranges narrow further, and only
`{python} n_par_nor_full` of the `{python} n_par_rows` combinations still span the full
characterization range. Narrowing is the expected outcome, because this analysis
compares the upper bound of a 95 % predictive interval against the limit instead of a
mean prediction, and the interval carries both the co-variation of the other factors and
the residual variance of the model.

```{python}
#| label: fig-par-hm
#| fig-cap: "Proven acceptable range for high mannose against culture pH, at set-point (left) and with the other factors varying within their normal operating ranges (right). The acceptable region is shaded green."
D.fig_par(UO, "high_mannose", D.governing_factor(UO, "high_mannose"))
```

@fig-par-hm gives the analysis for high mannose against
`{python} gov_name('high_mannose')`, which is the factor with the largest response
surface main effect on it. At set-point the whole characterized pH range is acceptable,
and under normal operating range co-variation the acceptable range becomes
`{python} par_nor('high_mannose','pH')`. The upper part of the characterized pH range no
longer holds the predictive bound below the in-process limit. The normal operating range
for culture pH is `{python} nor('pH')`, and the upper edge of that range sits just above
the co-varied bound.

```{python}
#| label: fig-par-gal
#| fig-cap: "Proven acceptable range for galactosylation against culture duration, at set-point and under normal operating range co-variation."
D.fig_par(UO, "galactosylation", D.governing_factor(UO, "galactosylation"))
```

Galactosylation is the binding attribute, and @fig-par-gal shows why. Under co-variation
the proven acceptable range for culture duration is
`{python} par_nor('galactosylation','duration')` days, and the normal operating range
for culture duration is `{python} nor('duration')` days. The lower edge of the normal
operating range therefore sits below the lower edge of the proven acceptable range. The
same pattern appears against dissolved carbon dioxide, where the range is
`{python} par_nor('galactosylation','co2')` mmHg against a normal operating range of
`{python} nor('co2')` mmHg. It appears again against culture temperature, where the
co-varied range of `{python} par_nor('galactosylation','temperature')` °C stops just
below the upper edge of the normal operating range of `{python} nor('temperature')` °C.

That is an adverse result, quantified here before it is dispositioned. At the corner of
the normal operating range where all four factors take their least favourable values at
once, `{python} wc_nor_corner('galactosylation')`, the model predicts galactosylation of
`{python} f"{wc_nor('galactosylation'):.1f}"` % against an in-process alert limit of
`{python} f"{ipc_hi('galactosylation'):.1f}"` %. Afucosylation reaches its own alert
limit of `{python} f"{ipc_hi('afucosylation'):.1f}"` % at the equivalent corner.

Three things bound that finding. The limit exceeded is an alert limit derived from the
demonstrated capability of the process, at `{python} f"{alert_sigma:g}"` standard
deviations above the simulated mean, and a limit of that construction is expected to be
exceeded by a small proportion of batches. The comparison is made at a simultaneous four
factor extreme, whereas the capability simulation draws the parameters independently:
over `{python} f"{n_mc:,}"` simulated batches the highest galactosylation was
`{python} f"{cap_max('galactosylation'):.1f}"` %. Against the drug substance criterion
of `{python} ds_range('galactosylation')` % there is no exceedance anywhere in the
normal operating range. An excursion of this kind is therefore an investigation trigger
under the in-process control strategy in §10, not a specification failure.

```{python}
#| label: fig-par-acid
#| fig-cap: "Proven acceptable range for acidic variants against dissolved CO2, at set-point and under normal operating range co-variation."
D.fig_par(UO, "acidic_variants", D.governing_factor(UO, "acidic_variants"))
```

@fig-par-acid gives the acidic variant analysis against
`{python} gov_name('acidic_variants')`, where the at set-point range starts at
`{python} par_sp('acidic_variants','co2')` mmHg and the co-varied range at
`{python} par_nor('acidic_variants','co2')` mmHg, both bounded at the low end because
low dissolved carbon dioxide raises the attribute. The normal operating range of
`{python} nor('co2')` mmHg extends below the co-varied bound, which is the same pattern
as galactosylation and has the same disposition.

```{python}
#| label: fig-par-afuc
#| fig-cap: "Proven acceptable range for afucosylation against culture duration, at set-point and under normal operating range co-variation."
D.fig_par(UO, "afucosylation", D.governing_factor(UO, "afucosylation"))
```

```{python}
#| label: fig-par-agg
#| fig-cap: "Proven acceptable range for aggregate against culture pH, at set-point and under normal operating range co-variation."
D.fig_par(UO, "aggregates_hmw", D.governing_factor(UO, "aggregates_hmw"))
```

@fig-par-afuc and @fig-par-agg complete the set, and afucosylation restricts culture
duration at the short end under both analyses, at
`{python} par_sp('afucosylation','duration')` days and
`{python} par_nor('afucosylation','duration')` days. Aggregate restricts culture pH only
under co-variation, at `{python} par_nor('aggregates_hmw','pH')`, and the at set-point
range covers the whole characterized span.

The relationship between these ranges and the design space needs stating explicitly. A
proven acceptable range is univariate, and each one holds only under the analysis that
produced it. The design space in §6 is the multivariate region, and where the whole
characterization range of a parameter is proven acceptable, the constraint that actually
binds the operating region is the multivariate corner, not any univariate range. Both
statements rest on the fitted response surface models and on the characterized ranges,
and neither extends beyond them.

# Process capability and robustness

For every attribute in @tbl-cqa, capability was estimated by simulating
`{python} f"{n_mc:,}"` commercial scale batches with every parameter drawn independently
inside the normal operating range and with the fitted models and the residual variance
applied, and @tbl-cap gives the result.

```{python}
#| output: asis
show(cap_for(br_keys))
print()
print(": Estimated commercial-scale capability for the attributes the bioreactor governs. {#tbl-cap}")
```

Across those batches, every attribute clears the drug substance criterion. The tightest
capability of the `{python} n_br_cqa` attributes is the one for
`{python} cpk_min_cqa.lower()`, at a Cpk of `{python} f"{cpk(cpk_min_key):.2f}"`. The
simulated mean behind that capability, `{python} f"{cap_mean(cpk_min_key):.2f}"` %, sits
`{python} f"{cap_margin(cpk_min_key):.2f}"` percentage points above the lower acceptance
limit of `{python} f"{ds_lo(cpk_min_key):g}"` %, which is
`{python} f"{cap_sigma(cpk_min_key):.1f}"` standard deviations of the simulated
distribution. The lower limit binds, not the upper one, and the highest value in
`{python} f"{n_mc:,}"` simulated batches was `{python} f"{cap_max(cpk_min_key):.1f}"` %
(@tbl-cap).

The reason `{python} cpk_min_cqa.lower()` is the tightest case is not that the process
controls the attribute poorly. High mannose carries the narrowest acceptance band
relative to the level the process runs at, at `{python} ds_range('high_mannose')` %
around a mean of `{python} f"{cap_mean('high_mannose'):.1f}"` %, and the attribute also
sits at very high criticality. Both facts about the attribute point the control strategy
at the two parameters that move it, which is what §10 does.

The widest capability is the one for `{python} cpk_max_cqa.lower()`, at a Cpk of
`{python} f"{cpk(cpk_max_key):.1f}"`, and an index of that size does not mean the
process is `{python} f"{cpk(cpk_max_key) / cpk(cpk_min_key):.0f}"` times better
controlled for aggregate than for high mannose. The index means the attribute sits far
from the limit that applies to it, at a simulated mean of
`{python} f"{cap_mean('aggregates_hmw'):.2f}"` % against a criterion of
`{python} ds_range('aggregates_hmw')` %, and the index should be read as showing that
aggregate does not constrain this step.

Host cell protein and residual DNA appear in @tbl-cap as drug substance outcomes, not as
bioreactor outputs. The bioreactor sets the burden entering the purification train, and
the capability shown for both is the result of that burden and the clearance the train
delivers. The clearance credit belongs to Protein A capture (PCR-005), cation exchange
(PCR-007) and anion exchange (PCR-008), and the consolidated position is in PCMR-001.

Two bounds apply to every index in @tbl-cap. Each is estimated from a qualified scale
down model with the parameters inside their normal operating ranges, and none is a
measurement at commercial scale. The simulation also assumes that the parameters vary
independently inside those ranges, which is why the corner analysis in §7 is reported
alongside it.

# Parameter classification

Classification follows the decision logic for process parameters (SOP-4001) and the
continuum of criticality in [@ichq9]. A parameter whose variability affects a critical
quality attribute is critical, and the distinction between a critical process parameter
and a well controlled critical process parameter is the risk of leaving the design
space, not the size of the effect [@amab2009]. The outcome for every parameter appears
in @tbl-params, and the rationale for each is below.

- Culture pH is a WC-CPP because it reaches significance on all `{python} n_resp` responses
  of the response surface model, including the largest effect on high mannose, and because
  the control
  system holds it to `{python} nor('pH')` against a proven acceptable range that covers the
  whole characterized span at set-point (@tbl-par).
- Culture temperature is a WC-CPP because it moves galactosylation, high mannose and acidic
  variants, and jacketed control holds it to `{python} nor('temperature')` °C inside a
  characterized range of `{python} rng('temperature')` °C.
- Dissolved carbon dioxide is a WC-CPP because it carries the largest effect in the study
  on acidic variants and a substantial effect on galactosylation, and sparge control holds
  it to `{python} nor('co2')` mmHg. Dissolved carbon dioxide is also the parameter most
  exposed to scale, which is why the characterized range reaches `{python} rng('co2')` mmHg.
- Osmolality is a WC-CPP because screening resolved effects on galactosylation and acidic
  variants, and although the parameter was not carried into the response surface design,
  the medium and feed recipe holds it to `{python} nor('osmolality')` mOsm. Classification
  on the screening result and on the recipe control (SOP-2004) is the conservative reading
  of a factor that was not modelled further.
- Culture duration is a WC-CPP because it carries the largest main effect on galactosylation
  and on afucosylation and sets the harvest impurity burden of the step, and the harvest
  schedule holds it to `{python} nor('duration')` days inside a characterized range of
  `{python} rng('duration')` days.
- Dissolved oxygen is a KPP because the univariate assessment linked it to growth and
  productivity with no measurable link to a quality attribute, and the vessel controls it
  to `{python} nor('do')` % of saturation (process consistency depends on it).
- Initial viable cell concentration is a KPP on the same basis, since the seed train
  delivers it to `{python} nor('ivcc')` × 10⁶ cells/mL and the parameter sets the growth
  trajectory without changing the released profile.
- Nutrient feed-1 volume is a KPP because the feed schedule delivers
  `{python} nor('feed_vol')` % of working volume and the parameter governs titre with no
  measured effect on product quality.
- Basal medium concentration is a GPP because the univariate assessment over
  `{python} rng('medium_conc')` X found no link to product quality, and none to process
  performance that would require control beyond the recipe (SOP-2004).

No parameter at this step is classified as a critical process parameter. The
`{python} n_wc` quality linked parameters are all held by the control system inside
ranges this study proved acceptable, the risk of an unnoticed excursion outside the
design space is correspondingly low, and that outcome matches the platform record for
the step [@amab2009].

Finally, null results were classified rather than dropped. Osmolality, dissolved carbon
dioxide and culture duration produce no measurable effect on high mannose across ranges
that are `{python} f"{ratio_lo:.1f}"` to `{python} f"{ratio_hi:.1f}"` times the width of
the control ranges, and that absence is evidence of robustness for the attribute of
highest criticality at this step. Those three culture parameters stay in the knowledge
space on that basis, and the evidence is bounded by the ranges screened.

# Contribution to the control strategy

Within the control strategy for A-Mab drug substance, the production bioreactor
contributes four elements, and each is stated below with the range or the document that
carries it.

The first element is parameter control: `{python} n_wc` quality linked parameters are
controlled to the normal operating ranges in @tbl-params, which lie inside the design
space (§6) apart from the corner identified in §7. Two of those parameters, culture pH and culture temperature, carry the most
weight, because they are the two that move high mannose, the attribute with the tightest
capability at this step.

The second element is in-process monitoring against the limits used in §6 and §7, which
sit inside the drug substance criteria by construction, at `{python} f"{alert_sigma:g}"`
standard deviations above the simulated mean for the attributes the train does not
modify. An excursion above one of those limits triggers investigation of the culture
rather than rejection of the batch, and the corner analysis in §7 shows which
combinations of parameter settings would produce one.

The third element is release testing, under which the glycan profile, the charge variant
profile and the size variant profile of the drug substance are tested against the
criteria in @tbl-cqa by the methods in @tbl-sops (AMV-3010, AMV-3011, AMV-3013). Testing
confirms the outcome; the parameter ranges and the in-process limits are what assure it.

The fourth element is the input the step provides to the purification train, where host
cell protein and residual DNA leave this step far above the drug substance criteria and
culture duration is the parameter that sets both burdens. Holding duration to
`{python} nor('duration')` days therefore bounds the load that Protein A capture, cation
exchange and anion exchange must clear, and the clearance itself is characterized in
PCR-005, PCR-007 and PCR-008.

Two things this step does not do should be equally clear. The step does not control host
cell protein or residual DNA to the drug substance criteria, and makes no viral clearance
claim of any kind. The consolidated control strategy, including the cumulative viral
clearance and the cross step credit for the shared attributes, is in PCMR-001.

# Discussion

After both designed experiments, the step is understood well enough to define a design
space and to justify the ranges Stage 2 will run. A screening design ranked the
`{python} n_scr_f` factors and a response surface design modelled the region defined by
the `{python} n_rsm_f` that screening retained: `{python} rsm_list`. The mechanistic
expectations carried into the study were confirmed for every response except acidic
variants, and the effects that matter most are the ones prior knowledge predicted would
matter.

Confidence in the scale down model is the load bearing assumption of everything above.
Reproducibility of the model at the centre point runs from
`{python} f"{cv_rsm_min:.1f}"` % to `{python} f"{cv_rsm_max:.1f}"` % relative standard
deviation, most of which is analytical, and the qualification under SOP-1001 matched the
model to at-scale data on the attributes this study measures. However, a scale down
model reproduces the response of a culture to the controlled parameters, not the
variability a commercial vessel adds. Design spaces are not confirmed at scale at the
edges of the ranges, and this one is no exception.

Three limitations qualify the conclusions, and each is managed forward with a named
control. The first limitation is the omission of osmolality from the response surface
design, where screening resolved a temperature by osmolality interaction on
galactosylation of `{python} f"{eff('galactosylation','temperature','osmolality'):.1f}"`
percentage points (p =
`{python} f"{eff_p('galactosylation','temperature','osmolality'):.3f}"`) and this report
claims nothing predictive about that term. Osmolality is managed by recipe control to
`{python} nor('osmolality')` mOsm and by the WC-CPP classification, and a move of the
medium or the feed strategy would require the interaction to be studied properly.

The second limitation is the strength of the lack of fit evidence: all `{python} n_resp`
models pass the test, and the test rests on `{python} f_rsm['galactosylation']['df_pe']`
degrees of freedom of pure error. Therefore a passing test bounds the evidence for the
model form without establishing it. For this reason the weakest model of the five is
`{python} lof_p_lo_resp.lower()` (p = `{python} f"{lof_p_lo:.2f}"`), which also carries
the lowest predicted R² at `{python} f"{pred_lo:.2f}"`. The very low criticality of that
attribute and the wide acceptance band are what make that acceptable, and the model is
used only to bound a range and not to predict a batch.

The third limitation is the univariate treatment of `{python} uv_list`, since
interactions between those four parameters and the five multivariate factors were not
studied. The classifications of those parameters in §9 rest on univariate evidence and
on the platform record, and a proposed change to two of them together falls outside this
report.

The deviations recorded during execution are summarized below (§13). Both were impact
assessed before the affected data were used: the dissolved carbon dioxide probe offset of
`{python} f"{dev_003_01_offset_mmhg:g}"` mmHg is smaller than the reproducibility of
every response it could affect, and the nutrient feed shortfall of
`{python} f"{dev_003_02_feed_deficit_pct:g}"` % left the delivered volume inside the
normal operating range. Neither altered a fitted effect, a classification or a range.

No parameter at this step required the most stringent control class. The five quality
linked parameters are all well controlled critical process parameters, because the
control system holds each of them inside a range this study proved acceptable and an
excursion would be detected in process. The parameter closest to needing more is culture
pH, since it moves every response including the one with the tightest capability, and the
co-varied proven acceptable range for culture pH in @tbl-par falls short of the
characterization range for every one of them.

# Conclusions

The production bioreactor is characterized and the operating region is defined, on a
response surface model over `{python} rsm_list` that describes the `{python} n_resp`
attributes the step forms at an R² of `{python} pct(r2_lo)` or better and with no
significant lack of fit against the centre point replicates.

That operating region is the multivariate space in those four parameters over which
every governed attribute stays within the in-process criterion, and it covers
`{python} f"{ds_pct:.0f}"` % of the characterized grid. The normal operating ranges in
@tbl-params lie inside the region apart from the single corner reported in §7. Proven
acceptable ranges are reported per attribute and per parameter in @tbl-par, under both
the at set-point and the co-varied analysis.

The attributes the step governs all meet the drug substance criteria at commercial
scale, on the estimate in @tbl-cap. The tightest capability of the `{python} n_br_cqa`
attributes is the one for `{python} cpk_min_cqa.lower()`, at a Cpk of
`{python} f"{cpk(cpk_min_key):.2f}"` and a margin of
`{python} f"{cap_margin(cpk_min_key):.2f}"` percentage points to the binding limit. Of
the `{python} n_par_tot` parameters, `{python} n_wc` are well controlled critical
process parameters, `{python} n_kpp` are key process parameters and the remaining one is
a general process parameter, and the step has no critical process parameter.

The `{python} dev_n` recorded deviations were investigated, retained and impact
assessed, and neither changed a classification or a range. The capability and the region
reported here are estimates from a qualified scale down model, and confirmation at
commercial scale is a Stage 2 activity. This report rolls up into PCMR-001.

# Deviations from the plan

During execution, `{python} dev_n` deviations were recorded against PCP-003. Each was
investigated, root caused and impact assessed before the affected data were used, both
were retained, and @tbl-dev gives the register.

```{python}
#| output: asis
print(dev_register(DOC))
print()
print(": Deviations recorded during execution of PCP-003. {#tbl-dev}")
```

Both entries are minor and both were detected by a check that the plan required, one in
process and one after execution, and neither invalidated a design or triggered
re-execution.

## DEV-003-01 — dissolved carbon dioxide probe drift

The dissolved carbon dioxide probe on the scale down bioreactor read
`{python} f"{dev_003_01_offset_mmhg:g}"` mmHg away from the offline reference during
screening run 4. The probe drift was detected by the routine comparison of in-process
monitoring against the offline reference, and the affected run had already completed
when the comparison was made.

The investigation of that drift attributed the offset to probe drift between scheduled
calibrations on equipment EQ-BRX-205, which was within its calibration interval at the
time of execution. The magnitude of the offset corresponds to
`{python} f"{dev01_coded:.2f}"` coded units of the dissolved carbon dioxide factor, or
`{python} f"{dev01_nor_pct:.0f}"` % of the width of the normal operating range, against
a characterization range of `{python} rng('co2')` mmHg. The actual dissolved carbon
dioxide level in the affected run stayed well inside the characterized range, and the
run remained a valid setting of the design.

The impact on the fitted effects is bounded by that magnitude. Applied to the largest
dissolved carbon dioxide effect in the study, on acidic variants, a misassignment of
`{python} f"{dev01_coded:.2f}"` coded units corresponds to a response shift of
`{python} f"{dev01_shift('acidic_variants'):.2f}"` percentage points. The centre point
standard deviation of the same response on the screening design is
`{python} f"{cen_sd('acidic_variants'):.2f}"` percentage points. The offset is smaller
than the reproducibility of the measurement it would have to move, and smaller still
relative to the glycan responses. The run was retained, and the probe was recalibrated
before the response surface design was executed.

## DEV-003-02 — nutrient feed-1 under-delivery

Nutrient feed-1 was under-delivered by `{python} f"{dev_003_02_feed_deficit_pct:g}"` %
of the scheduled volume on one centre point batch of the screening design, from lot
LOT-FED-3120. Post-execution mass reconciliation of that batch found the shortfall, and
investigation attributed it to a feed pump calibration offset.

On that batch, the delivered feed volume was `{python} f"{dev02_delivered:.1f}"` % of
working volume against a set-point of `{python} sp('feed_vol')` % and a normal operating
range of `{python} nor('feed_vol')` %. That feed volume kept the batch inside the normal
operating range for the parameter throughout, and nutrient feed-1 volume is classified
KPP on evidence that it governs titre rather than product quality (§9).

The affected batch is one of the `{python} cp_scr` screening centre points. The values
of that batch therefore enter the pure error term and not an effect estimate. For the
affected batch, the glycan responses were verified on `{python} dev_003_02_ver_n`
measurements under AMV-3010, whose intermediate precision of
`{python} f"{prec('AMV-3010'):.1f}"` % gives that verification set a 95 % confidence
half width of `{python} f"{dev_003_02_ci_hw:.2f}"` % relative, which puts a feed
shortfall of `{python} f"{dev_003_02_feed_deficit_pct:g}"` % below the level that
comparison can resolve. The batch was retained as a centre point, the pump was
recalibrated, and the feed delivery check was added to the in-process record for the
remaining runs.

Neither deviation changed a parameter classification, a fitted effect or a boundary of
the operating region. Both are closed.
